title: The apple test
description: One small record. Three different ways to make a decision.

is_apple.instructions: Does the record say the fruit is an apple?

count.instructions: How many apples are in the record?

title: At the support desk
description: Route a support message and decide how much attention it needs.
state: I paid for the annual plan yesterday, but my account still says free. I need to present to a client in two hours. Can someone help?

team.instructions: Which team is best placed to resolve this request?

time_sensitive.instructions: Does the customer mention a specific upcoming deadline?

urgency.instructions: How urgent is the request based only on the message?

title: What we don't know
description: Leave evidence out and compare how models express uncertainty.

state.package: A sealed, unlabelled cardboard box arrived at the front desk.

contains_glass.instructions: Does the box contain glass? Base the answer only on the available evidence.

title: Choose a working mode
description: Classify a task before deciding how to handle it.

state.task: Compare two proposed database schemas and explain the tradeoffs for a system handling frequent account transfers.

mode.instructions: Which mode best matches the requested work?

needs_generation.instructions: Does fulfilling the task require generating an explanation rather than choosing a fixed label?

title: Check a draft
description: Check a proposed reply against the facts it was given.

state.draft: Your refund has been approved and the money will arrive tomorrow.

supported.instructions: Are all factual claims in the draft supported by the facts?

action.instructions: What should happen to this draft?

criteria.revise: Makes claims that are unsupported or contradictory
criteria.clarify: The facts are too ambiguous to assess the draft
